## Context / immutable basis
This reconciler-test cohort contains 45 confirmed bloated prose blocks across exactly 10 file-impact paths. Condense repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, and obsolete history while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

The inventory and before-citations are pinned to `origin/main@d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1`. A path-scoped comparison through `9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45` found identical blobs. Implement from current `origin/main`; keep d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1 as the immutable before side. This leaf is one commit, so path checks use `HEAD^..HEAD`.

## Editing boundary and semantic guard
Edit only allowlisted comments/docstrings plus adjacent blank lines. Executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose stay unchanged. Rewrite stale RED/pre-fix language as current contracts.

For every path, parse immutable and final source with `ast.parse(source, type_comments=True)`; recursively strip only a leading `Expr(Constant(str))` from each `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, and `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require exact `ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False)` equality. A tokenizer guard separately preserves directive text/attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.

## Scope — 45 editable blocks
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_fail_loud_comment_errors.py` (2) — module and test_create_path_comment_drop_promotes_when_flag_on docstrings. Preserve warn-first default, flag-gated promotion, partial comment loss, and same-kind silent-no-op canaries.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_fail_loud_exit_and_preflight.py` (1) — module docstring beginning “beer-datum-bark…”. Preserve nonzero exit on recorded mutation failures, clean-pass zero exit, and nonfatal preflight warnings.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_handler_404_isolation.py` (3) — module and both test docstrings. Preserve per-mutation 404 isolation with batch continuation and propagation of non-404 HTTP failures.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_impossible_links_cicada.py` (12) — module and `store`; ten test docstrings anchored by structural refusal, one-attempt skip, durable store, reopen, endpoint comment, transient failure, warning cadence, third-ticket cycle, ancestor status, and commit-back staging. Preserve structural-only classification, precise invalidation, retry, persistence, and staging.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_peer_confirmations_backfill.py` (3) — module; test_backfill_never_overwrites_proven_evidence; and test_lost_update_backfill_and_snapshot_records_both_survive docstrings. Preserve absence-only grandfathering, no downgrade, snapshot upgrade, ordering on one shared store, and lost-update protection.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_peer_confirmations_snapshot.py` (8) — module docstring; docstrings of test_unobserved_issue_confirms_nothing, test_authoritative_empty_confirms_nothing_and_unconfirms_nothing, test_get_or_empty_idiom_would_break_the_trichotomy, test_inward_blocks_is_recorded_as_depends_on, test_reconfirmation_is_idempotent_and_does_not_rewrite, test_confirmation_failure_does_not_break_the_pass, and test_two_passes_over_unchanged_snapshot_do_not_rewrite_the_sidecar. Preserve absent/empty/present snapshot trichotomy, link direction, idempotence, fail-open persistence, and no sidecar rewrite.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_peer_confirmations_store.py` (5) — module and _LinkClient docstrings; docstrings of test_relation_scoped_key_does_not_confirm_a_sibling_relation, test_store_survives_snapshot_compaction_of_the_ticket_log, and test_commit_only_peer_confirmations_is_staged_and_committed. Preserve relation-scoped durable keys, protocol-shaped transport, compaction survival, and confirmation-only commit staging.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_sync_only_scalar_update_dispatch_heldout.py` (3) — module docstring; comments beginning “subprocess_env() (not dict(os.environ))…” and “The reconciler unit-test conftests inject…”. Preserve live --only and legacy-filter dispatch parity, secret-safe subprocess repr, and removal of inherited sandbox overrides.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_synced_fields_reporting_e6e9.py` (6) — module docstring; docstrings of test_a_completed_write_reports_every_field_it_sent, test_an_unreachable_transition_reports_nothing, test_a_400_illegal_transition_comment_fallback_reports_nothing, test_a_parent_only_mutation_reports_nothing, and test_the_handler_records_nothing_for_a_soft_failed_mutation. Preserve reporting only confirmed scalar writes across success, transition, 400-comment fallback, 404, parent-only, and handler aggregation paths.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_transition_error_soft_fail.py` (2) — module and test_transition_runtime_error_soft_fails_batch_continues docstrings. Preserve bare transition RuntimeError isolation, continued batch execution, and precise failure manifest recording.

## Consumers and protected directives
Pytest directly collects every impacted module; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py` is the deterministic prose-policy consumer. No targeted `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or doctest consumer was found. Seventeen directives: 2 union-attr ignores in fail-loud comments; 1 union-attr + 5 attr-defined in fail-loud exit; 1 arg-type in handler-404; 1 pragma + 3 E402 noqas + 1 arg-type in synced-fields; 3 union-attr in transition soft-fail. Preserve each complete directive token and its attached executable statement exactly.

## Independent review receipt
A reviewer who did not author the prose change must post exactly 45 leaf-linked TSV rows, one per edited block:
`path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session`

Both verdicts are `PASS`, citations use full SHAs, and every after count is lower. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly 45 allowlisted blocks change.
- [ ] Every changed block is shorter.
- [ ] Every changed block states only current rationale or constraints.
- [ ] Every unlisted prose block is byte-identical.
- [ ] `semantic` exits 0.
- [ ] `directives` exits 0.
- [ ] `paths` exits 0 for exactly 10 file-impact paths.
- [ ] `diff` exits 0.
- [ ] `hygiene` exits 0.
- [ ] `focused` exits 0.
- [ ] Untimed `full` exits 0.
- [ ] The non-author TSV has exactly 45 rows.
- [ ] TSV stable IDs are unique.
- [ ] Every row cites the full immutable-base SHA.
- [ ] Every row cites the full final SHA.
- [ ] Every row records `after_words < before_words`.
- [ ] Every row records `semantic-preservation=PASS`.
- [ ] Every row records `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] Every row names a non-author reviewer session.

## Verification
Run all seven structured commands: `semantic`, `directives`, `paths`, `diff`, `hygiene`, `focused`, and `full`. Executable guards prove behavior/directive/path preservation; the TSV decides each block’s semantic preservation and bloat removal.
